# Docker Hub images the integration suite pulls at test time — either the Floci gateway image
# itself or sibling containers Floci spawns. They are cached (docker save/load) in CI so test
# runs don't hit Docker Hub's anonymous pull rate limit. One image:tag per line; '#' comments and
# blank lines are ignored. Keep floci/floci in sync with TestImages.Floci, floci/floci-az with
# TestImages.FlociAz, floci/floci-gcp with TestImages.FlociGcp and floci/floci-oci with
# TestImages.FlociOci.
#
# ECR images (public.ecr.aws/lambda/*, public.ecr.aws/docker/library/alpine) are intentionally
# omitted: they don't count against Docker Hub limits.
